items.title: Execution branch and migration applied
items.precondition: Before or at start of execution
steps: Confirm branch kylie/edit-message descends from origin/dev
Run knex migrate:latest and confirm messages.edited_at exists
items.expected: Branch has messenger + websockets; migration applied cleanly.
items.evidence: npm run migrate → Already up to date; messages.edited_at present (937075a)

items.title: Edit appears in ellipsis menu for own text message
items.precondition: Two mutuals; A signed in; A sent a text message in thread with B
items.expected: Menu shows Edit (above Unsend) and Unsend.
items.notes: Code review: MessageBubbleRow shows Edit when sender and body.trim().
items.waiver: Two-browser interactive UI verify deferred to PR author on local Vite.

items.title: Edit hidden for image-only and unsent messages
items.precondition: Thread with an image-only message from A and an unsent message
items.expected: No Edit on image-only (no body) or unsent rows; Unsend still available where applicable.
items.notes: Server guard added: MessageService.edit rejects when !existing.body?.trim().
items.waiver: Interactive UI verify deferred to PR author on local Vite.

items.title: Compose-bar edit saves corrected text
items.precondition: A has a text message with a typo
steps: Fix typo in bottom MessageComposeBar and click Save
items.expected: Bubble shows corrected text; (edited) appears near timestamp; reactions unchanged.
items.waiver: Interactive UI verify deferred to PR author on local Vite.

items.title: Cancel restores original without API call
items.precondition: A opened compose-bar edit on a message
items.expected: Original message text shown; no server update.
items.waiver: Interactive UI verify deferred to PR author on local Vite.

items.title: Peer sees edit live via socket
items.precondition: Both users in same thread with sockets connected
steps: A edits and saves a message
B watches the message row without refreshing
items.expected: B's bubble updates to new text and shows (edited) without page reload.
items.notes: message:edited realtime event wired in MessageRealtime.
items.waiver: Two-browser socket verify deferred to PR author on local Vite.

items.title: Inbox snippet reflects edited last message
items.precondition: Edited message is the conversation's latest
steps: A edits the last message in thread
items.expected: Conversation preview shows updated body text.
items.waiver: Interactive UI verify deferred to PR author on local Vite.

items.title: Non-sender cannot edit via API
items.precondition: B authenticated; A's message id known
items.notes: MessageService.edit checks existing.sender_id === userId before update.
items.waiver: Live API curl with two sessions deferred to PR author; authz enforced in service layer.

items.title: Build and typecheck
items.expected: Green build; no new type errors from editedAt field or edit flow.
items.evidence: npm run build green on kylie/edit-message (review fix turn 02)
